alt.description:
Specifies the alternate text of the image for the avatar. Will instead set the aria-label when using children or initials; to hide the avatar
from assistive technologies when passing children or initials, pass an empty string to the alt prop.

children.description: Content rendered inside the avatar, such as custom svgs or icons. (React component or element)

className.description: Additional classes added to the avatar.

isBordered.description: Flag to indicate the avatar should have a border.

src.description: Specifies the URL of the image for the avatar.
